## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `fix(incidents): ...`)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] Prisma migration included for schema changes
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No copyrighted normative text in new catalog data (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
